flexible-vlan-tagging.explanation: The `flexible-vlan-tagging` command enables an interface to accept both single-tagged and double-tagged VLAN traffic, providing flexibility in handling various VLAN tagging formats.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit

set firewall family ethernet-switching f.explanation: This command configures an Ethernet-switching firewall filter named `[parameter1]` to apply packet filtering rules on Layer 2 traffic in Junos OS.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.explanation: Filter policy names, such as POLICY_8021P.

term [parameter2].explanation: The command fragment `term [parameter2]` in Junos defines a specific condition or rule within a firewall filter or policy, identified by `[parameter2]`.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: Policy item names, such as CLASS_8021P.

then dscp [parameter3].explanation: The command `then dscp [parameter3]` sets the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value in the IP header to the specified `[parameter3]` for traffic matching the filter.

then accept.explanation: The `then accept` command in Junos allows the traffic that matches the preceding conditions in the firewall filter or policy to pass through without further processing.
